text.hi: किताब: रिपोर्टर ने मीना से सवाल पूछे। मीना की बातों को ‘Meena says that ...’ से लिखो। उदाहरण: Meena says that she gets up early in the morning.
text.hinglish: Kitaab: reporter ne Meena se sawaal poochhe. Meena ki baaton ko ‘Meena says that ...’ se likho. Udaharan: Meena says that she gets up early in the morning.
text.en: The book: a reporter asked Meena questions. Write her answers with ‘Meena says that ...’. Example: Meena says that she gets up early in the morning.

steps.answer: Meena says that she runs 4 kilometres every day.

meaning.hi: मीना कहती है कि वह हर दिन 4 किलोमीटर दौड़ती है।
meaning.hinglish: Meena kehti hai ki woh har din 4 kilometre daudti hai.
